diagnosis.narrative: The series carries a moderate long-run trend. Seasonality is strong (period 52): a repeating cycle explains much of the movement. Predictability is middling — structured signal and irregular noise are balanced. The series reads as stationary by the ADF/KPSS tests. A few outliers stand out (10 points, ~1% of the sample). Across validation windows the model ranking is unstable (Kendall tau 0.01), which favours a robust combination.

The ranking is unstable and many models are correlated; a weighted combination over the full pool with inverse-error may bring in diverse models.
The series has strong seasonality and unstable ranking; a robust trimmed mean over the full pool may reduce influence of high‑error outliers.
The series is strongly seasonal and ranking is unstable, so a robust DBA combination over the full pool may improve over trimmed mean.
The series is strongly seasonal with unstable ranking; a per‑horizon weighted mean using softmax of negative error may capture complementary strengths across horizons.
The series has strong seasonality and unstable ranking; a simple mean over the full pool may offer a robust baseline different from weighted/trimming.
The series has unstable ranking and strong seasonality; a robust weighted combo on a small diverse pool (pool4) may outperform full‑pool weighted.
The series has unstable ranking and strong seasonality; a robust median over the full pool may reduce influence of outliers and correlated errors.
The ranking is unstable and several correlated groups exist; a robust DBA over a reduced, diverse pool may improve over median.
The series has strong seasonality and unstable ranking; a per‑horizon weighted mean may capture complementary strengths of the top models in pool5.
